beats.headline: The second quest
beats.text: Carl is an acolyte of Emberus now, and the paperwork comes with a brother attached. Hellik: god of sun and life, Emberus's twin, level 250, said around the celestial floors to be quite obsessed with killing his own brothers, and the likeliest hand behind Geyrun's death even though he was sitting in council with Emberus when it happened. Two quests arrive together with the acolyte's package. Find Out Who Killed My Son. Kill Hellik. The second one has a deadline attached and it is the twelfth floor.

beats.headline: The terms of a family feud
beats.text: What a god's grudge looks like when it is applied to one crawler. No magical item blessed by Hellik may be owned or used, so a whole category of loot is now dead weight. Every shrine of his is marked on the minimap. Every one of his adherents carries a symbol over their head and pays double experience when put down.

beats.headline: A temple in the Ursine town
beats.text: Temple of Hellik: a red diamond at the edge of Crawler Carl's map, in the large Ursine settlement across the bridge. Hellik is the brother and the enemy of Emberus, whom Carl worships. Carl holds a quest to kill this god, and is told he earns a bonus for every worshipper of Hellik he kills. There is no temple of Emberus in the town. He has declined to wade into that particular pool today. He has way too much else to deal with.

beats.headline: It stops being paperwork
beats.text: NPCs who worship Hellik now go hostile toward Carl the moment they see him, no provocation and no conversation required. Inside Club Vanquisher the clerics stand in front of a stained glass door they will tell you shows Hellik bringing truth to Apito, whatever that is supposed to mean. It does not show Hellik at all. It shows the brother above him, and the clerics have had that door wrong for centuries.

beats.headline: He turns up in person
beats.text: The temple goes up, the portal starts letting gods through into Club Vanquisher, and Khepri comes out with the rest of them. Hellik banishes him on sight, in front of everyone. Then he turns to Carl with a message for his brother: he did not kill Emberus's son, everything Carl has been told about him is a lie, Apito has been corrupted, and Nekhebit is the hand behind all of it. He asks for an alliance. The quest to kill him is still open in Carl's log while he says it.

beats.headline: The clock on the order
beats.text: Quemada worships Emberus too, and Quemada's professional opinion is that the standing order cannot sit unattended much longer. They need to make an attempt on Hellik, and soon. Nobody in that conversation raises what Hellik said in the club.
